items.title: Charlie Hamilton Interview, 1965-03-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] I remember that. Yeah. Subtle Stan was on that for a while too. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, and Walter Pichon was on there, well George stayed on there a year, and I stayed there with him.

ctx.x: I worked with George, oh just like I told you, a whole year for this WTPS radio place, and we broadcast every Sunday, we had to go up there and rehearse this program every week for the Riga B account.
I remember that. Yeah. Subtle Stan was on that for a while too.
Yeah, and Walter Pichon was on there, well George stayed on there a year, and I stayed there with him.
